questions: What is a driver?
If the driver is removed, does everything stop?
What is a clone?
If one clone is destroyed, are the others unchanged?
What is a checkpoint?
If the checkpoint is blocked, does everything get through?
What is escape?
If escape succeeds, is it gone for good?
What is transformation?
If the transformation is reversed, is everything back to normal?
What is a mutation?
If the mutation is corrected, does everything return to normal?
What is a target?
If the target is hit, is the job finished?
What is invasion?
If the invasion is stopped at the edge, is everything safe?
What is the burden?
When the burden gets smaller, is the problem over?
What is resistance?
If the resistance breaks, does it become easy to stop?
What is the grade?
If the grade goes up, is that a good result?
What is screening?
After the screening, does everyone know what happens?
What is a deletion?
After the deletion, can it be restored?
What is amplification?
If the amplification is turned down, is it gone?
What is a response?
If there is no response, did nothing change?
